description: Device-free RK3588 integer elementwise capture bundles derived from the kernel_6_18 and expt elementwise_int.py examples.

task_descriptor_contract.note: job.json follows the documented schema and does not encode task fields. The worker must use the source examples' known-safe descriptor: flags=0, op_idx=4, enable_mask=0x18, int_mask=0x300, int_clear=0x1FFFF, int_status=0, regcfg_offset=0, regcfg_amount=regcmd_words, regcmd_addr=regcmd BO address.

oracle_policy: expected.bin is a host-side pure-Python formula, not device data. expected.mask.bin marks asserted bytes with 0xFF and unasserted surface/BO padding with 0x00. Compare (actual & mask) == (expected & mask) over the full output BO.

validation.note: Host-side checks only; they do not validate RK3588 silicon.

coverage.fp32: Neither example defines an FP32 EW dtype or submits FP32 input. The expt FP16 pipelines consume configured FP32 constants, but those are non-integer probes and are not bundled here.
coverage.multi_input_sum: The only multi-input sum emitted by the sources is the FP16 run_fp16_four_input_pipeline; see the BLOCKED entry. No integer multi-input sum exists in either script.
coverage.relu_relu6_batchnorm: ReLU-X and PReLU are emitted only for FP16 BS/BN (BLOCKED entry). ReLU6 and batchnorm are not emitted by either example. No integer activation variant exists.
lane_shapes: 8-lane simple path: INT8/INT16 width=1 x channels=8; INT32 width=2 x channels=4
9-lane layout path: width=1 x channels=9 for INT8, INT16 and INT32
not_bundled_streams: FP16 BS/BN configured MINUS and external MUL (expt 1091-1632)
FP16 per-channel broadcast and SiLU LUT (expt 2001-2182)
INT32 ABS/NEG/FLOOR/CEIL and the INT32_MIN edge vectors

cases.description: INT32 MUL, eight lanes; source-captured limitation: EW MUL operand is signed INT16

oracle.formula: saturate_int32(a[i] * s16(b[i] & 0xffff)), s16(x) = x-65536 if x>=32768 else x
oracle.compare: masked byte equality over the full 4096-byte output BO; 0xFF mask bytes mark asserted lanes, 0x00 bytes are surface/BO padding
oracle.confidence: source-captured hardware limitation (kernel_6_18 lines 430-443); candidate behavior

notes: The full INT32 main cube is used, but the separate MUL operand decodes as signed INT16: 50000 -> -15536, -50000 -> 15536.
Do not treat this as full-width INT32 multiply.

cases.description: INT32 DIV probe (source submits it) with the other non-integer ALU modes
cases.blocked_reason: The source proves DIV/FLOOR/CEIL use floating-point semantics and are not integer operations (OPERATIONS[...]['integer_supported'] = False). There is no trustworthy integer oracle; bundling them as integer EW would mislabel the result. FLOOR and CEIL share this blocker.

cases.description: FP16 four-input sum: main + BRDMA(FP32) + NRDMA(FP32) + ERDMA(FP16)
cases.blocked_reason: The only multi-input sum in either source is FP16, with FP32 BRDMA/NRDMA operands. This family is integer-only (ew-int); an FP16/FP32 mixed case needs its own oracle and belongs in an ew-fp16 family. It is not an INT8/INT16/INT32 case and was deliberately not materialized here.

cases.description: FP16 BS/BN ReLU-X and PReLU probes
cases.blocked_reason: ReLU-X and PReLU are emitted only in the FP16 BS/BN auxiliary stages. No integer ReLU path exists in either source, and ReLU6 and batchnorm are never emitted at all. Not an integer elementwise case.
